name: erikwang2013/etcd
description: PHP etcd v3 client with gRPC + HTTP dual transport and the full v3 API (KV, Watch, Lease, Auth, Cluster, Maintenance). Runs on plain PHP: no framework, no PSR-18 implementation and no ext-curl required. Laravel, Hyperf, ThinkPHP and Webman adapters included.

suggest.psr/http-client: For the PSR-18 transport path via HttpTransport::setHttpClient(). Without it the client uses ext-curl, or PHP's stream wrapper when ext-curl is absent.
suggest.psr/http-factory: PSR-17 request/stream factories, used together with psr/http-client.
suggest.ext-curl: Fastest HTTP driver (default when loaded). Without it the client falls back to the stream wrapper.
suggest.grpc/grpc: For native gRPC transport (better performance, full watch streaming)
suggest.google/protobuf: For protobuf message support (required by gRPC transport)
